title: Quantum correlations · supplied and random interactions
description: Supplied chains, symmetric and random all-to-all interactions, and state controls. A stable correlation ranking or a low-dimensional projection is not operational locality or spacetime.
uncertainty: Archived percentile intervals and one-sided lower bounds are descriptive: independent calibration covered only 91.25% of known means at nominal 95%. They must not be read as validated confidence guarantees. Deterministic states have null intervals; exact chain-success bounds are separate.
sampleUnit: Whole independent coupling/preparation realizations; stochastic main cells have 24 units across three batches. Pairs, cuts, perturbations and repeated times are dependent within a unit. A symmetric deterministic preparation is one specified state.
assumptions: Fixed transverse-field Ising interactions; supplied tensor factors and external time. Mutual information measures total correlation. Participation rank is not a spacetime dimension. Uniform Model A has a degenerate MDS eigenspace. Its truncated three-dimensional stress and shuffle contrasts depend on an arbitrary basis and cannot support structural conclusions.
selection: Nineteen named scientific metrics from all 141 archived summary groups: 1,983 reported estimates and 60 explicit null rows for wholly undefined metrics declared by the source. Null rows have zero defined units and copied undefined counts. No field, preparation or adverse scalar result within that metric selection is filtered by outcome. Existing ci95 endpoints are split; batch means and other metrics remain in the source.
